text: 🚨🎙️| Fermín: "We knew this month would be tough but we're prepared. We're looking forward to this week. In the locker room there were no doubts despite knowing it's been hard for the culés." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Fermín: "We never like our fans to feel disappointed. The recent results have been disappointing, that's the truth. But we know the season is still long, and there are plenty of matches left to play. And as the coach said, titles are decided in May."  #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Joan García: "We lost against strong rivals but we remain leaders in the League. We must keep a cool head to continue as leaders." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Joan García: “It was a somewhat unusual defensive line for us. But Frenkie and Brian, in particular, showed great character and proved how good they are as players. Good players can deliver a good performance regardless of the position they play in. That’s exactly what both of them proved today. I’m very happy for them.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Joan García: “We also hope to recover the players who are currently absent as soon as possible.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on his 100th win: “Yes, of course I knew that. But in the end, the most important thing for me was to secure the win today and pick up those three points, just as I said before the match. That was extremely important for us, especially after the last two matches.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “The Champions League is always a special competition with its own unique character.We only have two days to recover after today’s match. Our focus right now is entirely on getting the players back to full fitness. After that, we’ll start preparing for the Aston Villa clash.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Brian and Frenkie: “I’m very happy with both of them. They delivered a very good performance today, and it’s positive to know we can RELY on them in these positions. Brian deserved this opportunity. He always acts with the utmost professionalism and has an excellent attitude. That’s exactly what we want from him.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: "My best position? For me it's the midfield, but if the team needs me in another position, I'm READY." #fcblive 🔥

𝐁𝐑𝐈𝐀𝐍 𝐅𝐀𝐑𝐈𝐍̃𝐀𝐒 🆚 Alavés:

• 7.1 rating
• 97% pass accuracy (100/103) 🎯
• 100% pass accuracy in own half (51/51)
• 94% pass accuracy in opposition half (49/52) 
• 3 Def. contributions 🚫 
• 6 recoveries 🔄

WHAT A DEBUT 🔥
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "I liked how we defended. I'm happy with how we dominated the first half." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "Frenkie de Jong? He told me he could play at center-back to help the team. Just like Fariñas at left-back. I hope some players return, but they've been at a good level." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Gavi: "We had to choose who to substitute. That's why Rodri finished the match and everyone must accept these decisions." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We are monitoring the progress of Eric and Jules, especially. We are waiting for their return. Andres Christensen is close to returning to training with the group." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “When Lamine scores two goals, it was easier to sub him. We talked about it at halftime. He's played well just like Fermín and Raphinha. It's the attitude I want after the two defeats." #fcblive
Hamza Abdelkarim shares a special moment with a young fan, gifting him his shirt and putting a smile on his face. 🔵🔴

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "My favourite win? I can't pick one victory from the past after the 100 wins. When I arrived at Barça I wanted to reach 100 matches. I'd stick with the victory in the FIRST Clásico." #fcblive 💙❤️
🚨🎙️| Fermín: "Manchester United Interest? I don't pay attention to that kind of news. I want to STAY here at Barça as long as possible, and I hope to END my football career at this club." #fcblive ❤️
